                 Accredited by NBA (B.Tech. – CSE, ECE, EEE, Mech.,Civil and IT) & NAAC with ‘A’ Grade 
Approved by AICTE, New Delhi permanently affiliated to JNTUA, Ananthapuram. 
   
 
Scheme for Promoting Interests, Creativity and Ethics among Students 
(SPICES) 
             All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE) offered financial assistance under the Scheme for 
Promoting Interests, Creativity and Ethics among Students (SPICES)  for the Financial Yea r 2022 -23 to 
Arts and Crafts club at Sri Venkateswar a College of Engineering, Tirupati.  The purpose of this scheme is to 
energize and position one of the clubs as facilitating entity for pursuit of individual’s interest, creativity work, 
showcasing talent, networking and teamwork opportunities, social experien ce, organization and management 
skills and exposure to professional ethics.  
 Arts and Crafts club has taken initiative and conducted various events such as Crafts making workshop , 
Reuse-Reduce and Recycle: Alternatives for waste management, Seed ball maki ng for ecological balance, 
Exhibition of house hold items for sustainable environment from waste material, Workshop on Painting and 
pencil sketching and Seminar on “Human Values and Professional Ethics”.  The events have been designed to 
bring out the hidden talents and skills of the students. Club coordinators took initiative and made the students to 
participate in all the events actively. All the events helped the students to develop artistic skills, organization 
and ethics. We are very much grateful to th e AICTE for providing financial assistance and  a great offer  to 
showcase our students’ talents. 
 The following are the reports about the events have been conducted in our institution.
